title: Flowing Datasets with Wasserstein over Wasserstein Gradient Flows
tldr_zh: 在 WoW 空间上建立梯度流理论，用 MMD-SW 目标流动整个带标签数据集，应用于迁移学习与蒸馏
tldr_en: Defines gradient flows on the Wasserstein-over-Wasserstein space to flow entire labeled datasets for transfer learning and distillation
